videos.headline: Monmouth shakes off fumble to score 93-yard TD
videos.description: Lonnie Moore IV takes a big hit on a kickoff return and fumbles the ball. Monmouth is able to recover to keep possession, leading to Pete Guerriero running in a 93-yard touchdown on the next play.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One Play (Monmouth shakes off fumble to score 93-yard TD) 2019/12/07 ESHEET

videos.headline: JMU gets on the board with a 49-yard TD
videos.description: Ben DiNucci throws a short, quick pass and Brandon Polk takes it to the house for a 49-yard James Madison touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One Play (JMU gets on the board with a 49-yard TD) 2019/12/07 ESHET

videos.headline: Brown goes for 21 yards to score
videos.description: Ben DiNucci throws through the middle gap to Jake Brown, who completes the play with a 21-yard touchdown to give James Madison the lead.
